name: Parlor Palm
hook: Brown frond tips? Your palm wants softer water.

steps.title: Bright shade, or low light
steps.tip: Bright, indirect light is best, but it tolerates low light. Direct summer sun scorches the fronds.

steps.title: Water when the top is dry
steps.tip: Water once the surface dries, then empty the tray. Rainwater is best; hard tap water browns the leaves.

steps.title: Warm, with no cold drafts
steps.tip: Best at 20–27°C from spring to autumn; cooler winters are fine. Keep it away from drafty windows.

steps.title: Feed monthly, not winter
steps.tip: Give a balanced liquid feed once a month from spring to autumn, and nothing in winter.

steps.title: Keep the pot snug
steps.tip: It grows slowly. Repot in spring only when roots are crowded, into a pot about 2 cm wider.

steps.title: Mist against spider mites
steps.tip: Spider mites, scale and mealybugs are the main pests. Misting and wiping the leaves helps keep them off.

outro: Soft water, bright shade and a snug pot: a palm that lasts for years.

sources.title: NC State Plant Toolbox: Chamaedorea elegans
